about: SW-S2: every model the product can run, with its exact revision, the checksum of its files, a saved copy of its licence, and the prompt and schema it goes with. A model is made champion for a role by a setting (CDI_CHAMPION_EXTRACTION, CDI_CHAMPION_HANDWRITING, CDI_CHAMPION_PRINTED); the service refuses a champion that is not listed here, that has no licence text saved, or whose prompt has changed since it was registered. Facts below are copied from the Licence Register and SBOM (pod) sheets of the backlog (2026-10-04) or read from the installed package; null means not known yet - never guessed.

roles.extraction: reads the whole page into the structured form (RD-S4)
roles.printed: reads the printed lines of a page (RD-S1)
